units: <cite ref="Beitzah 25b:2">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>הרי זה ר׳</he> he is considered a glutton.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 16:3:3">Y. Sabb. XVI, 15ᵈ</cite> top <he>ולר׳ כדי מזונו</he> and for a great eater (we may save from fire on the Sabbath) as much as he needs for his meal.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 7:5">B. Mets. VII, 5</cite> <he>מלמדין … שלא יהא ר׳ וכ׳</he> we teach man that he (as a field laborer) must not be greedy, and that he should close the door before him (restrain his appetite for drink); a. e.
